audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly placed at 3-5, level 6, first item and late; Gnar's own spike (a full Rage bar) is tracked throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry repeatedly tells you to survive Gnar's poke with Meditate and never states that Mega Gnar's Wallop stun and GNAR! both cancel the channel. It also credits Yi with 'lifesteal' at levels 4-5, which is not in his kit — his level 4-5 sustain is Meditate. breakdown.cooldowns puts Boomerang Throw in the W slot; Boomerang Throw is Q, Hyper is W.
audit.why: Meditate is a channel and any hard CC cancels it; Wallop is a 7s stun in Mega form and GNAR! stuns anything slammed into a wall. Healing inside Wallop range is exactly the mistake the entry was steering the player into. Highlander's slow immunity does correctly answer his Boomerang and Hop slows — that part was already right and is preserved.
audit.corrected: Cancellation written into spikes[1], mid and breakdown.mid; whys[3] now names Meditate; breakdown.cooldowns fixed to Boomerang Throw (Q, 16s) and Hop (E, 22s).

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stabilize as Wuju Style true damage and Meditate sustain let you punish any Gnar who walks up to last-hit, healing back his Boomerang chip. Level 6 is your pivot: Highlander's move speed, attack speed and slow immunity finally let you stick to mini Gnar through his E hops — Alpha Strike in, Wuju autos, and he can't kite a slow-immune Yi.

edits.before: You get Highlander (R) and true DPS online — once your Meditate (W) and lifesteal let you survive his poke, you can Alpha Strike onto him and out-sustain, so the lane tips your way here.
edits.after: You get Highlander (R) and true DPS online, and its slow immunity ignores his Boomerang slow — but Meditate is a channel that Mega's Wallop stun cancels, so heal only after that 7s stun is spent.

edits.before: By 4-5 your lifesteal and Meditate (W) let you eat the poke, and at 6 Highlander (R) turns you into a real duelist who can Alpha Strike in and out-sustain his damage. Pick fights when his Rage bar is empty so there's no Mega stun waiting.
